metadata.summary: Retirement has been confirmed for Daryz following the successful defence of his Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe crown.
metadata.content: Daryz retired: Francis-Henri Graffard's dual Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe hero heads to stud for owners Aga Khan | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Daryz retired: Francis-Henri Graffard's dual Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe hero heads to stud for owners Aga Khan Daryz became the first colt since 1978 to win back-to-back Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe titles last Sunday; owned by the Aga Khan Studs, he will now start his new career as a sire; Christophe Soumillon in to ride Calandagan on Champions Day at Ascot Friday 9 October 2026 13:41, UK Image: Daryz became the first colt since 1978 to win back-to-back Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe titles Retirement has been confirmed for Daryz following the successful defence of his Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe crown. Francis-Henri Graffard's four-year-old became the first colt since Alleged in 1977 and 1978 to land back-to-back renewals of Europe's premier middle-distance contest, while he is the ninth dual winner overall. No horse has ever won the Arc three times, but Daryz will not be bidding for the hat-trick in 12 months' time, with a second career in the breeding shed awaiting him next year. Doyle: Castle can defend his unbeaten record in Dewhurst Weekend Winners: Kate, Sam and Declan have their say on Silver Trophy In all Daryz won nine of his 12 career starts, earning almost £5.5million in prize-money. messages.text: Djokovic suffers shock second-round exit in Shanghai and Fery beaten

metadata.summary: Novak Djokovic suffered a shock second-round exit at the Shanghai Masters, losing in straight sets to Hubert Hurkacz on Friday.
metadata.content: Novak Djokovic knocked out of Shanghai Masters in second round as Britain's Arthur Fery is also beaten | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Novak Djokovic knocked out of Shanghai Masters in second round as Britain's Arthur Fery is also beaten Novak Djokovic, who won the China Open on Tuesday for the 102nd title of his career, goes down 6-4 6-3 to Hubert Hurkacz in his Shanghai opener; Arthur Fery beaten by 26th seed Karen Khachanov in epic three-setter; top seed Alexander Zverev through to third round Friday 9 October 2026 13:36, UK Image: Novak Djokovic lost his opening match of the Shanghai Masters Novak Djokovic suffered a shock second-round exit at the Shanghai Masters, losing in straight sets to Hubert Hurkacz on Friday. Djokovic was on a high coming into the tournament after claiming a seventh China Open title - and the 102nd of his career - on Tuesday, albeit he didn't have to win a match point in either the semi-final or final. Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from their final-four clash after hitting a spectator with the ball , while Alex De Minaur retired hurt after dropping the first set of the final, ⁠with Djokovic leading 7-6 (7-3) 0-1. messages.text: Wolff: People who think Mercedes favour Antonelli should watch Teletubbies

metadata.summary: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff says people who believe the team have favoured Kimi Antonelli over George Russell this season are "brainless" and should watch Teletubbies and Mickey Mouse instead of Formula 1.
metadata.content: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff says people who think team favour Kimi Antonelli over George Russell are 'brainless' and should 'watch Teletubbies' | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mercedes boss Toto Wolff says people who think team favour Kimi Antonelli over George Russell are 'brainless' and should 'watch Teletubbies' Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions Mercedes have favoured championship leader Kimi Antonelli over his team-mate George Russell; watch the Singapore Sprint on Saturday at 10am (build-up from 9am) ahead of Qualifying at 2pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event Friday 9 October 2026 12:50, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Toto Wolff hits back at accusations that Mercedes favour Kimi Antonelli over George Russell. Mercedes chief Toto Wolff says people who believe the team have favoured Kimi Antonelli over George Russell this season are "brainless" and should watch Teletubbies and Mickey Mouse instead of Formula 1. Antonelli has defied pre-season expectations to build an 84-point lead over Russell at the top of the Drivers' Championship with just seven races remaining, including this weekend's Singapore Grand Prix. Wolff offered a scathing response to the suggestion Mercedes do not treat their drivers equally, which included a reference to criticism the team previously faced from Lewis Hamilton fans before the seven-time world champion left to join Ferrari. messages.text: Transcript: What Maresca said on Man City charges verdict

metadata.content: Man City charges: Enzo Maresca's first press conference after guilty verdict from independent Premier League commission | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man City charges: Enzo Maresca's first press conference after guilty verdict from independent Premier League commission Enzo Maresca held his first press conference since Manchester City were found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules; Maresca spoke for 15 minutes on Friday ahead of their match against Liverpool on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Friday 9 October 2026 13:57, UK Q. You referred to the controversy surrounding City as noise. Is that somewhat dismissive of the genuine anger felt by many towards the findings of the commission? Do you understand the outrage and anger? First of all, morning. I understand the reason why most of you are here. But the only thing I can say is stuff I already said. There is a process ongoing and, in this moment, I completely trust the club. This is what I can say about that. Q. Why do you trust the club? Have you sought clarity from them? Have you seen the irrefutable evidence they refer to? Your predecessor, Pep Guardiola, once said if the club is relegated, he would stay. Will you give that commitment as well? First of all, I trust the club because I trust the people and that is why I joined the club. There is not another club in the world where I would like to be. I'm very happy to be here.
